pairs.target: shào lǐ lái hái bù de shíhòu ,
pairs.english: When Shaoli came to return the cloth,
pairs.hanzi: 邵里来还布的时候，

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèngzài gěi xìnfēng tú jiànghu .
pairs.english: Tavi was spreading paste on an envelope.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正在给信封涂浆糊。

pairs.target: tā bǎ gānjìng de bù tān zài zhuōshàng ,
pairs.english: He spread the clean cloth on the table,
pairs.hanzi: 他把干净的布摊在桌上，

pairs.target: biānjiǎo yā zhe yíkuài táng , tángzhǐ yǐjīng bèi tǐwēn wù dé fāruǎn .
pairs.english: with a sweet weighing down one corner; its wrapper had already softened from body warmth.
pairs.hanzi: 边角压着一块糖，糖纸已经被体温焐得发软。

pairs.target: " bié bāo jìnqù . " shào lǐ shuō , " huì bǎ xìn niánzhù . "
pairs.english: “Don't wrap it inside,” Shaoli said. “It'll stick the letter shut.”
pairs.hanzi: “别包进去。”邵里说，“会把信粘住。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái yě méi dǎsuàn bǎ táng jìzǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi hadn't intended to post the sweet anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来也没打算把糖寄走。

pairs.target: tā kàn le kàn nà zhī shǒu .
pairs.english: He looked at that hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他看了看那只手。

pairs.target: mǔzhǐ gēn de hóng yìn dàn le , shào lǐ què réng yòng lìngyìzhī shǒu līn shūdài .
pairs.english: The red mark at the base of the thumb had faded, but Shaoli still carried his book bag in the other hand.
pairs.hanzi: 拇指根的红印淡了，邵里却仍用另一只手拎书袋。

pairs.target: " wòbǐ méishì . tí dōngxī hái suān . "
pairs.english: “Holding a pen is fine. Carrying things still aches.”
pairs.hanzi: “握笔没事。提东西还酸。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán , cái wèn tǎ wéi xiàwǔ yǒuméiyǒu kōng .
pairs.english: Only after saying this did he ask whether Tavi was free that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完，才问塔维下午有没有空。

pairs.target: lí nàcì shānlù kè yǐjīng guò le sìtiān .
pairs.english: Four days had passed since that mountain-road class.
pairs.hanzi: 离那次山路课已经过了四天。

pairs.target: shào lǐ de ānzhì kǎohé dìng zài sāntiān hòu ,
pairs.english: Shaoli's placement assessment was set for three days later;
pairs.hanzi: 邵里的安置考核定在三天后，

pairs.target: jièlái de liànxí jià zhǐnéng yòngdào jīntiān bàngwǎn .
pairs.english: he could only use the borrowed practice rig until that evening.
pairs.hanzi: 借来的练习架只能用到今天傍晚。

pairs.target: tā xūyào yígè tì tā jì shí de rén .
pairs.english: He needed someone to time him.
pairs.hanzi: 他需要一个替他记时的人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ hái qiàn liǎngyè tú suàn , zhèngyào tuīcí ,
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the two pages of graphical calculations he still owed, and was about to decline,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起自己还欠两页图算，正要推辞，

pairs.target: shào lǐ yǐjīng bǔ le yíjù : " bú tì wǒ dòng qìjù . cuò le yě bié tíxǐng . "
pairs.english: when Shaoli added, “Don't handle the equipment for me. Don't warn me if I make a mistake, either.”
pairs.hanzi: 邵里已经补了一句：“不替我动器具。错了也别提醒。”

pairs.target: zhè dǎo jiào tǎ wéi yǒuxiē xiǎng qù .
pairs.english: That actually made Tavi rather want to go.
pairs.hanzi: 这倒叫塔维有些想去。

pairs.target: tā xiān bǎ jiāxìn tóu jìnmén fáng de yóudài ,
pairs.english: First he dropped his letter home into the gatekeeper's mail sack,
pairs.hanzi: 他先把家信投进门房的邮袋，

pairs.target: wǔhòu dài zhe zìjǐ de zuòyè dào le dōng wū .
pairs.english: then brought his homework to the east room after lunch.
pairs.hanzi: 午后带着自己的作业到了东屋。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zuòzài ménkǒu gǎi juàn ; zhè duàn shíchén yóu tā zhíshǒu ,
pairs.english: Instructor Vey sat marking papers by the door; she was supervising this session,
pairs.hanzi: 维老师坐在门口改卷；这段时辰由她值守，

pairs.target: wūlǐ zhǐyǒu liǎngzhāng jiàzi huòzhǔn shǐyòng .
pairs.english: and only two rigs in the room were approved for use.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里只有两张架子获准使用。

pairs.target: dé mǎ zhàn zhe kàochuāng de yìzhāng , zhèngzài bǎ xiǎo fǎmǎ zhúgè bǎihuí hélǐ .
pairs.english: Dema had the one beside the window and was returning the small weights to their box one by one.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛占着靠窗的一张，正在把小砝码逐个摆回盒里。

pairs.target: shào lǐ de liànxítí shì yìzhī qiǎn mùpán .
pairs.english: Shaoli's exercise used a shallow wooden tray.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里的练习题是一只浅木盘。

pairs.target: pándǐ pù shā , liǎnggè tiěpiàn gè yā zhe yìgēn qīng mùgān ,
pairs.english: Sand covered its bottom; two iron strips each pressed on a light wooden lever,
pairs.hanzi: 盘底铺沙，两个铁片各压着一根轻木杆，

pairs.target: gāntóu guà zhe bùtóng de xìshéng .
pairs.english: with different thin cords hanging from the lever ends.
pairs.hanzi: 杆头挂着不同的细绳。

pairs.target: tí zhǐ yào tā zài gěidìng de fànwéi nèi wánchéng yícì jiè xìng , zài àn shùnxù xièxià fùzài .
pairs.english: The question sheet required one exchange within the specified range, then removal of the loads in order.
pairs.hanzi: 题纸要他在给定的范围内完成一次借性，再按顺序卸下负载。

pairs.target: pángbiān lìng fàng zhe sānzhī fēng hǎo de yàng hé , gòng tā tiāoxuǎn pèiduì cáiliào .
pairs.english: Three sealed sample boxes were set beside it for him to choose paired materials from.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边另放着三只封好的样盒，供他挑选配对材料。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dúwán tí , míngbái wèishénme bùxǔ tíxǐng le .
pairs.english: Reading the question, Tavi understood why reminders were forbidden.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读完题，明白为什么不许提醒了。

pairs.target: yàng hé wài de chǐcùn biǎo hěn xiàng , zhǐyǒu yìháng hòudù bùtóng ;
pairs.english: The dimension tables on the boxes looked alike, with only one thickness entry different;
pairs.hanzi: 样盒外的尺寸表很像，只有一行厚度不同；

pairs.target: tā zìjǐ yě kěnéng kànlòu .
pairs.english: he might have missed it himself.
pairs.hanzi: 他自己也可能看漏。

pairs.target: kāishǐ hòu , shào lǐ xiān bǎihǎo le mùpán , què méiyǒu lìjí chāi hé .
pairs.english: Once started, Shaoli arranged the tray but didn't open the boxes immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 开始后，邵里先摆好了木盘，却没有立即拆盒。

pairs.target: tā yòng zhǐ fù dǐzhù yígè kōng mùbǐng , wòjǐn , sōngkāi , méitóu zhòu le yíxià .
pairs.english: He pressed his fingertips against an empty wooden handle, gripped it, released it, and frowned.
pairs.hanzi: 他用指腹抵住一个空木柄，握紧，松开，眉头皱了一下。

pairs.target: shālòu lǐ de shā búduàn luòxià .
pairs.english: The sand in the hourglass kept falling.
pairs.hanzi: 沙漏里的沙不断落下。

pairs.target: " néng tíng ma ? " tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù wèn .
pairs.english: “Can you stop?” Tavi couldn't help asking.
pairs.hanzi: “能停吗？”塔维忍不住问。

pairs.target: shào lǐ dèng le tā yìyǎn , suíjí bǎ zhuōbiān de xiǎo mùpái fān le guòlái .
pairs.english: Shaoli glared at him, then flipped over the small wooden sign at the table's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里瞪了他一眼，随即把桌边的小木牌翻了过来。

pairs.target: bèimiàn xiě zhe " zàntíng ".
pairs.english: “Pause” was written on the back.
pairs.hanzi: 背面写着“暂停”。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zǒu guòlái , tīng tā shuō wòjǐn shí mǔzhǐ hái suān , biàn shōuqǐ le jiēchù yòng de liǎngpiàn tiě .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey came over; hearing that his thumb still ached when he gripped, she put away the two contact strips.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师走过来，听他说握紧时拇指还酸，便收起了接触用的两片铁。

pairs.target: tā kěyǐ jìxù cáiliào pàndú hé xièzài shùnxù , jīntiān bú zuò jiè xìng .
pairs.english: He could continue material identification and the unloading sequence, but no exchange today.
pairs.hanzi: 他可以继续材料判读和卸载顺序，今天不做借性。

pairs.target: " zhèngshì kǎohé yě zhèyàng ? " shào lǐ wèn .
pairs.english: “Is it the same in the actual assessment?” Shaoli asked.
pairs.hanzi: “正式考核也这样？”邵里问。

pairs.target: " nǐ dé shēnbào . jiēchù nà yíxiàng néng bunéng lìng pái , yào kǎohé chù dáfù . "
pairs.english: “You must report it. The assessment office must decide whether the contact section can be rescheduled.”
pairs.hanzi: “你得申报。接触那一项能不能另排，要考核处答复。”

pairs.target: " lìng pái jiù kěnéng méiyǒu wǒ yào de gōngwèi . "
pairs.english: “Rescheduling could mean losing the position I want.”
pairs.hanzi: “另排就可能没有我要的工位。”

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī méiyǒu fǎnbó .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey didn't argue.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师没有反驳。

pairs.target: tā bǎ rìqī xiě zài liànxí jìlù shàng , ràng tā míngzǎo dài zhe jìlù qù wèn .
pairs.english: She wrote the date in the practice record and told him to take it along and ask the next morning.
pairs.hanzi: 她把日期写在练习记录上，让他明早带着记录去问。

pairs.target: ménwài yǒurén bān guò yíluò yǐzi , yǐ jiǎo zhuàng zhe ménkuàng , xiǎng le sānxià .
pairs.english: Outside, someone carried past a stack of chairs, their legs knocking against the doorframe three times.
pairs.hanzi: 门外有人搬过一摞椅子，椅脚撞着门框，响了三下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe shālòu , bù zhīdào hái gāibugāi jì shí .
pairs.english: Tavi stared at the hourglass, unsure whether to keep timing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯着沙漏，不知道还该不该记时。

pairs.target: shào lǐ bǎ zìjǐ de míngzì huàdiào , yòu xiě huí yuánchù , zhǐ shàng duō le yígè hěn hēi de gēda .
pairs.english: Shaoli crossed out his name, then wrote it back in the same place, leaving a dark blot on the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里把自己的名字划掉，又写回原处，纸上多了一个很黑的疙瘩。

pairs.target: " jiēzhe . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Continue,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “接着。”他说。

pairs.target: shèngxià de liànxí bǐ tǎ wéi yǐwéi de nán .
pairs.english: The rest of the exercise was harder than Tavi had expected.
pairs.hanzi: 剩下的练习比塔维以为的难。

pairs.target: shào lǐ xuǎn duì le yàng hé , què xiān jiě le duǎnshéng ;
pairs.english: Shaoli chose the right sample box, but untied the short cord first;
pairs.hanzi: 邵里选对了样盒，却先解了短绳；

pairs.target: mùgān piānzhuǎn , qīngqīng pèngshàng shāmiàn .
pairs.english: the wooden lever swung sideways and lightly touched the sand.
pairs.hanzi: 木杆偏转，轻轻碰上沙面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàozhe tí zhǐhuà le yígè chā , méiyǒu shuō " chàyìdiǎn ".
pairs.english: Tavi marked a cross following the question sheet, without saying “Nearly.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维照着题纸画了一个叉，没有说“差一点”。

pairs.target: dìèrbiàn huàn yòng kōng jià yǎnshì shùnxù shí ,
pairs.english: The second time, demonstrating the sequence on the empty rig,
pairs.hanzi: 第二遍换用空架演示顺序时，

pairs.target: shào lǐ bǎ liǎnggēn shéng de wèizhì chóngxīn biāo qīng , cái shùnlì xièwán .
pairs.english: Shaoli clearly marked both cords' positions again, and only then unloaded successfully.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里把两根绳的位置重新标清，才顺利卸完。

pairs.target: dé mǎ shōu hǎo zìjǐ de dōngxī , còu guòlái kàn jìlù .
pairs.english: Dema packed her things and came over to look at the record.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛收好自己的东西，凑过来看记录。

pairs.target: " nǐ xuǎn de shì chéngnán shuǐzhá ? " tā wèn . " nàlǐ lúnbān yǒu sùshè . "
pairs.english: “You chose the southern sluice?” she asked. “The shifts there include accommodation.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你选的是城南水闸？”她问。
“那里轮班有宿舍。”

pairs.target: " biéchù méiyǒu ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Other places don't?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “别处没有？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " yǒuxiē zhī gěi yèbān de rén liú chuáng . huàn le bān , zìjǐ zhǎo dìfāng zhù . "
pairs.english: “Some only keep beds for night-shift workers. Change shifts, and you find your own place.”
pairs.hanzi: “有些只给夜班的人留床。换了班，自己找地方住。”

pairs.target: shào lǐ dītóu èn píng juǎnqǐ de zhǐ jiǎo ,
pairs.english: Shaoli pressed down a curling corner of the paper, his head lowered.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里低头摁平卷起的纸角，

pairs.target: " wǒ qù kànguò chéngnán . sìgè rén yìjiān , chuānghù cháo hé , tiān bú liàng jiù yǒu chuán guòqù . "
pairs.english: “I went to see the southern site. Four people to a room, the window facing the river; boats go past before dawn.”
pairs.hanzi: “我去看过城南。四个人一间，窗户朝河，天不亮就有船过去。”

pairs.target: tā shuōqǐ nà shàn chuāng de shíhòu , shēngyīn hūrán bú xiàngshì zài tán kǎohé le .
pairs.english: When he spoke about that window, he suddenly sounded as though he wasn't discussing an assessment.
pairs.hanzi: 他说起那扇窗的时候，声音忽然不像是在谈考核了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngdào zìjǐ gāng lái xuégōng shí , lián yìzhāng shǐzhōng shǔyú zìjǐ de chuáng dōu juéde shēchǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered how, on first arriving at the academy, even a bed that was always his had seemed a luxury.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想到自己刚来学宫时，连一张始终属于自己的床都觉得奢侈。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng shuō háiyǒu biéde dìfāng , kě tā gēnběn méi kànguò nàxiē dìfāng .
pairs.english: He wanted to say there were other places, but he had never even seen them.
pairs.hanzi: 他想说还有别的地方，可他根本没看过那些地方。

pairs.target: " děng dáfù ba . " tā zuìhòu shuō .
pairs.english: “Wait for the answer,” he said at last.
pairs.hanzi: “等答复吧。”他最后说。

pairs.target: shào lǐ táiqǐ tóu : " wǒ búhuì zhī děng . wǒ míngzǎo qù wèn , xiàwǔ qù kànkàn lìngwài liǎnggè gōngwèi . "
pairs.english: Shaoli looked up. “I won't just wait. I'll ask tomorrow morning, then look at the other two positions in the afternoon.”
pairs.hanzi: 邵里抬起头：“我不会只等。我明早去问，下午去看看另外两个工位。”

pairs.target: dé mǎ diǎndiǎntóu . tā yuánběn xiàngshì hái xiǎng shuō shénme , zhèshí zhī bǎ luò zài dìshàng de hégài jiǎnqǐlái .
pairs.english: Dema nodded. She had seemed about to say more, but now she only picked up the lid from the floor.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛点点头。她原本像是还想说什么，这时只把落在地上的盒盖捡起来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái zhīdào , shào lǐ qiǎng de bìng bù zhǐshì yígè xiě zài bǎng shàng de hǎo míngcì .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi understand that Shaoli was fighting for more than a good ranking on a list.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才知道，邵里抢的并不只是一个写在榜上的好名次。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn líkāi dōng wū , shào lǐ zài shuǐcáo biān xǐ nà zhī méi zhān shā de shǒu , xǐ dé hěn màn .
pairs.english: Leaving the east room at dusk, Shaoli washed his unsandy hand at the sink, very slowly.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚离开东屋，邵里在水槽边洗那只没沾沙的手，洗得很慢。

pairs.target: " nàtiān chīfàn de shíhòu , wǒ shuō nǐ bǎ dōngxī nònghuàile . "
pairs.english: “At dinner that day, I said you'd broken those things.”
pairs.hanzi: “那天吃饭的时候，我说你把东西弄坏了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíng zài liǎngbù wài .
pairs.english: Tavi stopped two steps away.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维停在两步外。

pairs.target: " wǒ tīng le biérén dehuà . " shào lǐ bǎ shuǐguān xiǎo , " kě huà shì wǒ shuō de .
pairs.english: “I listened to someone else.” Shaoli turned the water down. “But I was the one who said it.”
pairs.hanzi: “我听了别人的话。”邵里把水关小，“可话是我说的。

pairs.target: míngtiān chīfàn , wǒhuì gēn nà zhuō rén shuō qīngchǔ . "
pairs.english: “At dinner tomorrow, I'll set it right with the people at that table.”
pairs.hanzi: 明天吃饭，我会跟那桌人说清楚。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng le yíhuìer , cái shuō : " luò héng yě zài . tā jìguò de dōngxī , nǐ dāngshí bùkěn kàn . "
pairs.english: Tavi waited a moment before saying, “Lohen was there too. You wouldn't look at his records then.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等了一会儿，才说：“洛衡也在。他记过的东西，你当时不肯看。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . " tāmen méiyǒu yìqǐ qù fàntáng .
pairs.english: “I know.” They didn't go to the dining hall together.
pairs.hanzi:
“我知道。”
他们没有一起去饭堂。

pairs.target: shào lǐ huíqù ná kǎohébiǎo , tǎ wéi hái dé bǔ zuòyè .
pairs.english: Shaoli went back for his assessment form; Tavi still had homework to finish.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里回去拿考核表，塔维还得补作业。

pairs.target: jìnmén shí pà wò wèn táng nǎ lái de , tā bāi chéng liǎngkuài , dì le yíkuài guòqù .
pairs.english: As he came in, Pavo asked where the sweet came from; he broke it in two and handed over a piece.
pairs.hanzi: 进门时帕沃问糖哪来的，他掰成两块，递了一块过去。

pairs.target: táng nián zài yá shàng , tián dé rén búdàhǎo shuōhuà .
pairs.english: The sugar stuck to his teeth, so sweet it made speaking awkward.
pairs.hanzi: 糖粘在牙上，甜得人不大好说话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ jì shí zhǐjiá jìn shū lǐ , fānkāi qiàn zhe de nà liǎngyè ,
